Frequent enough to be frustrating. The ads also glitch and I have to back out of what I’m watching and wait hours for the ads to work so I can progress in the show I’m watching. Last month the SEPHORA ADS drove me away. I hated those ads and they came 4-5 back to back. Of course, they would glitch and start all over again. Além disso, há muita propaganda repetitiva e que se mantém em sequência, um mesmo anúncio reproduzido 5 vezes sem intervalo de tempo, a gente mal consegue assistir o episódio de tanta interrupção. Sei que o intuito do app é que os usuários assinem um plano, mas eu por exemplo, já sou assinante de outros streamings e uso o viki só no horário de almoço no trabalho, pelo celular, então não compensa pra mim assinar, e se fosse assinar pra assistir num curto período de tempo, eu gostaria que tivesse um plano mais acessível, talvez com número de horas diárias, por exemplo: 5,99 por 4 horas diárias, daria pra ver uns 2 episódios por dia, o que já é mais do que suficiente. Em tempos onde o consumidor mal tem tempo pra assistir conteúdo, pois existe as redes sociais, Netflix, Amazon, Disney, etc. Além do YouTube, as pessoas em suas horas vagas (que são pouquíssimo tempo) acabam assistindo outras coisas, então assinar um plano em vários apps acaba não sendo acessível pra quem mal tem tempo de assistir alguma coisa, devido ao dia a dia cheio de compromissos, faculdade, trabalho, etc.

reviews.title: Extremely long ad breaks
reviews.text:
When I first started using the app a little while ago the amount of ads was very reasonable, maybe thirty seconds at a time, but they have increased to an intolerable amount. In a 45 minute episode there are at least 4 ad breaks, not including the ones that play when you open a video. There are five unskippable ads in each break, either 15 or 30 seconds long. If you’re lucky that’s still over a minute of ads, but they are typically all 30 second ads, which is almost three minutes of ads every break! If there are four ad breaks, that means you spend well over ten minutes watching ads throughout the episode, which is unacceptable. 

Not to mention the breaks are not timed nicely, often in the middle of sentences or during emotionally tense build ups, which ruins the flow of watching. I don’t think it would be hard to place breaks in between scenes so I don’t think this haphazardness is acceptable either.

I will quit the app for a while and try it again later to see if they’ve cut down on the ads. If not, I’ll just delete it.

reviews.title: Missing basic functions that should be added! (Both Mobile & TV app)
reviews.text: I like the shows available and have watched something I enjoyed over 2 years years ago. Today Im trying to rewatch the same series with a friend and I’m unable to simply restart the episodes. When I click the episode I want to watch it brings me to the end of the episode from 2 years ago and wont let me click a button to restart. I have to watch ads when it loads then rewind very slowly which triggers more ads then when it starts the episode over finally I’m hit with even more ads after the show intro is over. A simple restart episode button would make up for this! It’s very inconvenient and makes this service almost not worth using having deal with all the xtra ads just because I have to restart the episodes. Don’t misunderstand, I’m not asking for no ads in the free version I’m just asking not to be forced to watch 3 sets of ad breaks before I can even start the show. It doesn’t do that when I start an episode I hadn’t already seen before.
